purpose: Close the 2-adic/modular escape left open by the characteristic-zero proof: test whether exact Boolean elimination of a rank-r determinant update can use one copy of the core over a commutative local ring such as Z/2^kZ.

model.ring: Any nonzero commutative local ring R.
model.rank_r_update: M -> M + U V^T with r>=2.
model.one_core_augmentation: N=[[M,U R0],[-L0 V^T,D]], where D,L0,R0 are independent of M,U,V and the top-left block contains exactly one copy of M.
model.target: det N = det M + det(M+UV^T) for all sizes/entries for which the symbolic identity is defined.

theorem.name: NO_EXACT_ONE_CORE_LOCAL_BOOLEAN_ELIMINATION_FOR_RANK_R_GE_2_OVER_NONZERO_COMMUTATIVE_LOCAL_RINGS_V1_3
proof: For invertible symbolic M set K=V^T M^{-1}U. Schur complement in M gives det N = det(M) det(D+L0 K R0). Universality requires det(D+L0 K R0)=1+det(I_r+K) as a polynomial identity in K.

The degree-r coefficient of the right side is the unit 1 multiplying det(K). In a local ring, if every r x r minor contribution from L0, R0 or the complementary D-minor were a nonunit, their sum would lie in the unique maximal ideal and could not equal 1. Hence some r x r minor of L0 and of R0 and the corresponding complementary D-minor are units.

Using invertible row and column changes, normalize those unit minors so L0=[I_r;0] and R0=[I_r,0]. The transformed determinant differs only by an overall unit u. The coefficient of det(K) then equals det(A), where A is the auxiliary complementary block; matching the target makes det(A)=u, so A is invertible.
Schur complement in A reduces the normalized identity to det(K+S)=1+det(I_r+K), after cancellation of the unit leading coefficient.
For p!=q, the coefficient of the near-full nonprincipal minor K[[r]\{p},[r]\{q}] is, up to sign, S[q,p], while the target has no such term. Hence all off-diagonal entries of S are zero.
The coefficient of the near-full principal minor K[[r]\{p},[r]\{p}] is S[p,p], while the target coefficient is 1. Hence S=I_r.
The constant coefficient on the left is det(S)=1, while the target constant coefficient is 1+det(I_r)=2. Thus 1=2, forcing 1=0, contradicting that R is nonzero.
theorem.scope: Covers Z/2^kZ, p-adic local quotients, finite fields and other nonzero commutative local rings. It does not cover genuinely nonlocal simultaneous elimination, multiple coupled copies of the core with a proven polynomial total size, or nonlinear formula-dependent transforms.

algorithmic_consequence.killed: The hoped-for 2-adic/modular repair of the v0.8 one-core Schur elimination route for rank r>=2.
survives: decision-only p-adic/tropical constructions that do not reduce to the frozen one-core identity

next_target.name: E8_DECISION_ONLY_PADIC_CONSISTENCY_PENALTY_V1_4
next_target.directive: Move away from exact #SAT projection. Use occurrence-local clause determinants plus a polynomial-bitlength base B>2^n and a nonnegative disagreement penalty P(z), so the residue/valuation separates existence of a consistent satisfying assignment. Then seek a polynomial evaluation that avoids exact counting and does not reduce to the killed one-core rank-r model.
next_target.firewall: A reformulation whose evaluation remains #P/NP-hard is not an algorithm. Promotion requires explicit polynomial construct+solve+reconstruct+verify bounds.
